{{Quote|While our capital ships are vulnerable to the enemy's attack, I believe a squad of bombers can outmaneuver their ion weapon. Our target will be the bridge&hellip; and General Grievous.|Anakin Skywalker, to Shadow Squadron|audio=OurTargetIsTheBridge-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
The '''Battle of the Kaliida Nebula''' took place near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] discovery of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] developed a plan to attack the warship and its [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered Grievous to target the Republic's secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]], and the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|eradication]] of a Republic medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] identified the warship's quarry to the Republic. Skywalker planned to intercept the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], accompanied by his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], as well as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

Skywalker arrived at the medical station via a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] with the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], and engaged [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] launched from the ''Malevolence''. Suffering losses from the warship's [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]], Skywalker led his squadron to attack the vessel's starboard [[Ion cannon/Legends|cannon]]. When the ''Malevolence'' attempted to use the damaged weapon on the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]], the [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] exploded, causing further damage to the ship. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived with several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and engaged the fleeing ''Malevolence'', which was unable to retreat to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] because of damage to its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

Dooku's [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], used his alter ego as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine to trick [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] into traveling to the nebula, where Grievous could use her as a hostage and escape. Amidala arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was pulled aboard the ''Malevolence''. Skywalker and Kenobi arrived on the warship via Skywalker's personal ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], and rescued Amidala. Kenobi attempted to cause further damage to the warship's hyperdrive, but was confronted by Grievous and forced to engage the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] before escaping. Skywalker and Amidala sabotaged the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], and the group returned to the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. When the ''Malevolence'' attempted to jump to hyperspace, it crashed into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]], and Grievous retreated.

==Prelude==
===The mystery weapon===
{{Quote|Finding it is one thing. Finding a way to stop it is another.|Jedi Master Mace Windu of the Jedi High Council, regarding the ''Malevolence''|<ref name="Shakedown">''[[The Clone Wars: Shakedown]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Abregado.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Malevolence'' attacks Plo Koon's fleet in the Abregado system.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], capable of defeating numerous [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. The [[Ion cannon/Legends|cannons]] neutralized all power to their targets, leaving their prey defenseless without the ability to use [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and vulnerable to fire from the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] began a [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|series of strikes]] on Republic task forces that left no survivors to tell the Republic of the weapon or its methods of attack, leading the ''Malevolence'' to be dubbed the "mystery weapon" for its unknown nature.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> The attacks formed no pattern,<ref name="Shakedown" /> and the unpredictability of future targets drove fear throughout the Republic.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] volunteered to lead a hunt for the mysterious weapon and took a fleet of several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], where the ''Malevolence'' had been located. On Grievous's order, the warship attacked the Republic fleet with its ion [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] launched several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was aboard the warship and ordered [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] to eliminate the pods with [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding craft]], not intending to allow the Republic to learn of the warship and its weapons. However, Koon and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and were able to escape the ''Malevolence'', taking the knowledge of the warship to the Republic. Dooku, displeased with Grievous, left to discuss the general's failure with his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

===Preparing a counterattack===
{{Quote|Our bombers will attack at high speed to avoid the enemy's ion weapon. We'll concentrate our firepower on the bridge superstructure, here. We destroy Grievous, we can bring the war to a quicker end.|Anakin Skywalker, to Shadow Squadron|audio=BringWarToQuickerEnd-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_briefs_Shadow_Squadron.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker briefs Shadow Squadron on the plan.]]
Following the revelation of the superweapon's nature, Skywalker planned to lead a counterattack against the ''Malevolence'' with [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> The Jedi applied for several [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] through [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]], but discovered that they were still in the experimental stage. Skywalker also learned that the request had to come via a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] Committee. Unable to obtain the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] through official means, Skywalker traveled directly to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|testing facility]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] where the fighters were being manufactured. Arriving with Shadow Squadron aboard his personal [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], Skywalker took the bombers under the pretense that the request had come from Palpatine himself.<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref>

Returning to his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /> Skywalker developed a plan to lead Shadow Squadron on a direct attack on the ''Malevolence'', believing that while the larger cruisers could not outmaneuver the warship, the bombers would be able to slip through the warship's defenses. The squadron's target was the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where General Grievous would be maintaining command. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Grievous, Skywalker believed that the war could be brought to a quicker end. Skywalker began preparations for his departure, and was to be accompanied by Tano and Plo Koon, the latter of whom chose to fly in ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'', his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

===A new target===
{{Quote|I have the coordinates for a new target. The Republic's secret Outer Rim medical station. It is unprotected and treating over 60,000 wounded clones. We will do them a favor and put them out of their misery. Once you have destroyed it, there will be nowhere for the Jedi to send their wounded, and they will die.|Count Dooku gives the new target to Grievous|audio=NewTargetCoordinates-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku met with [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious and learned of the Republic's secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] medical station, the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], which was treating over 60,000 wounded Republic [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. As the ''Malevolence'' [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|ambushed]] a Republic medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], Dooku contacted Grievous and ordered the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general to target the medical center; without the medical base, the Republic would have nowhere to send its wounded clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Grievous was pleased with this new assignment, as it showed that the count had not lost all faith in him since his failure to prevent the escape of the Jedi during the Battle of Abregado. The ''Malevolence'' eradicated the convoy and proceeded to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]; however, as it was unable to pass through the nearby [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], the warship was forced to take a longer route around to the medical center.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

[[File:Btlbywing.png|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Squadron departs the Republic fleet.]]
As Skywalker learned of the convoy's defeat from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], the Jedi deduced that the medical center was the warship's next target. Skywalker intended to take Shadow Squadron on a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] through the nebula in order to arrive at the medical station before the warship, and planned to attack the ''Malevolence'' before it could destroy the base. Admiral Yularen and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] resolved to take a hyperspace route around the nebula, planning to arrive at the medical center to reinforce Skywalker with several ''Venator''-class cruisers,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> including the ''Resolute'', as well as Kenobi's flagship, the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']]. Yularen warned the medical center's [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]], of the impending danger,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /> and Kenobi contacted the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of the nearby planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]; several [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] were sent to help evacuate the medical center.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Skywalker, Tano, Koon,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|another Jedi Knight]]<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> departed the Republic fleet with Shadow Squadron. Upon entering the nebula, they encountered several [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray mantas]],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and Skywalker ordered the squadron to assume the single-file [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]] and follow him out of the nebula. [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilot]] [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] fighter was damaged,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /> but the mantas did not cause any casualties apart from pilot [[Contrail/Legends|Contrail's]] [[R2-J8/Legends|astromech droid]]. Shadow Squadron arrived at the medical center, located in the Ryndellia [[Star system/Legends|system]], shortly before the ''Malevolence'' came out of hyperspace and approached the station. By this time, the medical center had evacuated half of its patients with the help of the ''Pelta''-class frigates, but the clones being treated in [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] were unable to be moved.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==The battle==
===Attack on the ''Malevolence''===
{{Quote|Shadow Squadron, new target. We're taking out the starboard ion cannon.|Anakin Skywalker|audio=ShadowSquadronNewTarget-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Malevolence_attack_run.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker leads the attack run on the ''Malevolence''.]]
As Skywalker, Tano, Koon,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;flying a Delta-7B interceptor<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" />&mdash;and Shadow Squadron approached, the ''Malevolence'' attacked the fleeing ''Pelta''-class frigates with its ion cannons. After the frigates had been eradicated, several squadrons of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] were launched from the ''Malevolence'', and the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] attacked the incoming Shadow Squadron. Despite the fact that his own Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would be caught in the blast, Grievous ordered the warship's ion cannon to target the approaching Y-wing bombers. As the ''Malevolence'' fired its ion cannon, Skywalker immediately ordered his squadron to head for the top edge of the ray to avoid being neutralized. However, Matchstick's fighter malfunctioned, and his fighter crashed into fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] bomber, while [[Flyby|Shadow Six]], [[Shadow Seven/Legends|Seven]], and [[Shadow Ten/Legends|Ten]], were caught in the ion ray.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Even with its numbers cut in half, the Republic squadron continued toward the ''Malevolence'' and maneuvered through the incoming laser fire as the warship targeted the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]]. Another of the Republic fighters had been destroyed, and Tano advised Skywalker that with their decreasing firepower, targeting the bridge was not their best option. Taking Koon's suggestion to obliterate the warship's primary weapon, Skywalker changed the target to the starboard ion cannon, and he, Koon,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and the Jedi Knight spearheaded the attack on the cannon.<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> After the cannon was hit by [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], Grievous attempted to fire the weapon, but both cannons exploded, causing further damage to the ship and disabling the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Kenobi's fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] arrived in the star system and directed laser fire at the Confederate warship. Unable to retreat to hyperspace, Grievous ordered the ''Malevolence'' to flee to Confederate-held [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Kenobi contacted Skywalker and congratulated him on his success, and Skywalker, Tano, Koon<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and the Jedi Knight went to the medical station to regroup<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> and refuel their fighters to provide support for the Republic fleet.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

===Mission aboard the ''Malevolence''===
{{Quote|I'm being pulled inside the droid cruiser by a tractor beam. I will ''not'' be made a Separatist bargaining chip. ''Continue your attack!'' You ''must'' destroy this monstrous ship!|Padmé Amidala, to the commanders assembled aboard the ''Resolute''|audio=SeparatistBargainingChip-DM.flac|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
When Dooku learned of Grievous' failure, he was displeased,<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> and his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Master, Darth Sidious, arranged a trap for an important Republic official that would provide an opportunity for Grievous to escape. Sidious, in the guise of his alter ego of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, manipulated Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] into traveling to the nebula, under the pretense that she would be meeting with an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] representative that wanted to negotiate a treaty with the Republic. Amidala agreed<ref name="Agenda">''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]''</ref> and headed to the nebula in her [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht (Malevolence)/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]] with her [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. As the Republic fleet continued its attack on the fleeing ''Malevolence'', Amidala arrived out of hyperspace in front of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} bow and realized that she had been led into a trap.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

[[File:PadmeAmidalasHtypeNubianYachtMalevolence-DestroyMalevolence.png|thumb|left|250px|Amidala's yacht is pulled into the tractor beam of the ''Malevolence''.]]
Skywalker and Tano returned to the ''Resolute'', and Skywalker contacted [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] for support, but discovered that she was busy [[Battle near the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|fighting]] Confederate reinforcements nearby. Admiral Yularen deduced that the warship's hyperdrive was damaged because the ''Malevolence'' was not attempting to flee to hyperspace. Taking advantage of the warship's vulnerability, Kenobi ordered all laser fire to be directed at the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} bridge. The ''Resolute'' picked up the arrival of Amidala's [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|yacht]] and contacted the ship, and Skywalker was dismayed to learn of Amidala's presence,<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> as she was his secret [[Marriage/Legends|wife]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> To protect the senator, the Republic fleet was forced to cease its laser fire at the ''Malevolence''. Amidala's ship was pulled aboard the ''Malevolence'' with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], as Grievous intended to use the senator as a hostage to ensure the warship's escape. To rescue the senator, Skywalker and Kenobi departed in the ''Twilight'' to infiltrate the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

Trapped in the main hangar of the warship, Amidala set her [[Yacht/Legends|yacht's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] before escaping and hiding elsewhere with C-3PO, intending to delay her pursuers. As Grievous arrived to apprehend the senator, the ship discharged, but the cyborg general survived the explosion and ordered a full search of the ship. While attempting to contact the Republic fleet from a communications panel, Amidala and C-3PO were forced to hide from Grievous and a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] patrol. The senator and her protocol droid learned that the damage to the warship's hyperdrive would require less time to repair than originally believed, and Grievous left to inform Dooku of the news while the droids continued the search for the senator.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

As Skywalker and Kenobi arrived on the warship, they encountered several B1 battle droids and eliminated them. Back aboard the ''Resolute'', Tano and Koon again contacted Unduli for support, and Unduli stated that she was on her way to the nebula with reinforcements. Amidala contacted the Republic fleet, and Tano patched the communication through to Skywalker and Kenobi, who arranged to rendezvous with Amidala at a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] junction in the middle of the ship. Upon arrival at the junction, Amidala and C-3PO were ambushed by a battle droid patrol, and the senator returned fire at the droids while she and her protocol droid backed toward the rail jets. Noticing the senator's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, Skywalker and Kenobi immediately ignited their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jumped]] across rail jet cars, dispatching several battle droids on their way to the senator. Amidala and C-3PO escaped onto separate rail jet cars,<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> but a [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA series super battle droid]]<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> fired a rocket at the junction Amidala's car was approaching, and Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] Amidala onto his car. Kenobi attempted to telekinetically retrieve C-3PO, but the droid was caught on an oncoming car and headed off in another direction.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

====Dual sabotage====
{{Quote|General Kenobi, did you really think I would leave the hyperdrive ''unguarded?"<br />''"Anything is possible. You haven't exactly impressed me today.|Grievous and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
Upon learning from Amidala the battle droids' progress on repairing the hyperdrive, Kenobi elected to disable the hyperdrive while Skywalker and Amidala decided to sabotage the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] of the ''Malevolence''. Heading to the warship's bridge with the senator, Skywalker dispatched his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], to rescue C-3PO. The astromech droid halted the protocol droid's rail jet car and led him back to the ''Twilight''. Grievous, however, was able to intercept the transmission between Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala, and the cyborg general proceeded to the ship's hyperdrive room to ambush Kenobi. As the Jedi entered the room and approached the battle droids guarding the hyperdrive, droid reinforcements arrived alongside Grievous and targeted Kenobi. Using several [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] against their comrades, Kenobi Force-pushed two of the droids at the approaching battle droids behind them, then used the remaining droideka's deflector shield as protection from incoming [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] fire from Grievous.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> Evenly matched with Grievous, Kenobi chose to escape,<ref name="Destroy Malevolence Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961d00cd58011d027b86e90004|text=Dataclip: Destroy ''Malevolence''|na=video file}}</ref> forcing the remaining droideka at Grievous and fleeing. Knocking a B1 battle droid aside in frustration, Grievous ordered the remaining droids to guard the hyperdrive while he personally went to deal with Kenobi.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

[[File:Kenobi_vs_Grievous_Malevolence.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous confronts Kenobi.]]
As Kenobi left, he contacted Skywalker and Amidala, who were meanwhile fighting a patrol of several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. Kenobi arranged to meet the pair back at the ''Twilight'' before their communications were jammed by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} droid crew. At the rail jet, Kenobi was pursued by Grievous and several battle droids. The general and the droids jumped toward the Jedi's rail jet car, but the battle droids were destroyed from an incoming rail jet. As Grievous approached, Kenobi noticed a large, mechanical arm hanging over the rail jet and used it to propel himself toward Grievous, landing a kick on the general. The Jedi and cyborg engaged in a duel before Kenobi fled to the front of the car. Grievous slashed at the Jedi, making Kenobi lose his balance, but the Jedi was able to escape onto a car below.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

Skywalker and Amidala arrived on the bridge of the warship and dispatched the droids that were repairing the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} hyperdrive. Two super battle droids entered the room, and Skywalker quickly Force-pushed Amidala back into the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] before destroying the droids. Intending to reset the navicomputer's coordinates for the hyperspace jump, Skywalker hot-wired the warship's systems while Amidala hid the disabled droids in the turbolift chamber to erase any traces of the fight and evidence of the sabotage. Meanwhile, the Republic fleet prepared to attack the ''Malevolence'' once the Jedi returned with the senator, but with communications blocked, the cruisers were unable to contact Skywalker for an update of the mission's status. Finishing their mission, Skywalker and Amidala left the bridge shortly before more battle droids arrived to take command of the ''Malevolence''. The Jedi and senator met up with R2-D2 and C-3PO, and at the airlock where the ''Twilight'' was docked, Kenobi arrived, pursued by several droidekas. Skywalker used the Force to hover crates and provide cover for Kenobi, and the Republic group boarded the ''Twilight'' and escaped.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|Uh, the navicomputer is heading us right into the moon!''"<br />"''Fools! Reset the navicomputer!|A battle droid and Grievous|audio=ResetTheNavicomputer-DM.flac|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Malevolence_boom.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Malevolence'' crashes into the Dead Moon of Antar.]]
By this time, the ''Malevolence'' had reached the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The ''Twilight'' retreated to the Republic fleet, and Grievous gave pursuit in his fighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], accompanied by several Vulture droids. Aboard the ''Resolute'', Koon ordered the Star Destroyers to open fire once more, and the cruisers regained their attack on the fleeing ''Malevolence''. As Grievous landed a shot on the ''Twilight'', Amidala took charge of the laser cannon's periscope controls and returned fire at the droid starfighters. The cyborg general ordered the ''Malevolence'' to flee to the Confederate [[Sector Four Confederacy base/Legends|base]] in [[Sector Four (Confederacy)/Legends|Sector Four]], stating that he would meet the warship there, and the ''Malevolence'' maneuvered for the jump to hyperspace.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

Amidala aimed a shot at ''Soulless One'', and Grievous moved aside, forcing a Vulture droid to take the shot. As the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} crew engaged the warship's hyperdrive, the navicomputer malfunctioned and directed the warship toward the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> Dooku made contact with Grievous, stating that the ''Malevolence'' and the general himself were being awaited at the rendezvous point, but Grievous cut off the transmission and escaped to hyperspace. The warship's battle droid crew was unable to reset the navicomputer in time, and the ''Malevolence'' crashed into the dead moon, ending the threat that the Confederate warship had posed to the Republic.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I imagine you had something to do with that.''"<br />"''All part of the plan, Master.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, shortly after the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Vebb_Fisto_Grievous.png|thumb|right|300px|Grievous is forced to prove his worth following the loss of the ''Malevolence'' and other such losses.]]
The destruction of the ''Malevolence'' earned a smattering applause from the crews aboard the Republic Star Destroyers.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> The dead moon of Antar became the resting place<ref name="CSWE" /> of what had been the Confederacy's prized warship. Grievous' defeat at the hands of the Republic further shook Count Dooku's faith in him.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> It was the destruction of the ''Malevolence'', in addition to a number of [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|following]] [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|defeats]],<ref name="Chronicling TCW 4">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-4|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #4|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref> that prompted Dooku to arrange a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|test]] for his general later in the war.<ref name="Forces of Darkness">''[[The Clone Wars: Forces of Darkness]]''</ref><ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

Following the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula,<ref name="OEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> a clone trooper squad under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] was sent to the remains of the ''Malevolence'' to confirm that it had been built by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Separatists at [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]]. A piece of scrap with the insignia of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]], a starship-construction organization that was based out of [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]], was recovered from the destroyed warship, but a circuit board that had not been manufactured by the Quarrens was also found amongst the debris. After the clone squad's return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the piece was sent to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] was able to confirm that the board was built by [[KynachTech Industries]], a worker force based out of [[Kynachi|his own homeworld]]. Master Ambase and the clone trooper squad were [[Mission to Kynachi|dispatched]] to Kynachi to follow the lead, unaware that they were heading into a trap set by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] Darth Sidious.<ref name="Breakout Squad" />

Eventually, the Confederacy decided to rebuild the ''Malevolence'', and Grievous personally supervised the operation. Once Grievous and a battle droid squad had [[Skirmish on the Dead Moon of Antar|eluded]] the Jedi Knight<ref name="CWA: Card Commander">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref> who had participated in the initial assault on the ''Malevolence'',<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> they retrieved the necessary information from the ship's crash site on the dead moon of Antar. As Pammant Docks began to reconstruct the [[Malevolence (II)|new ''Malevolence'']], the Jedi Knight [[Mission to Pammant|pursued]] Grievous to Pammant and dueled both Grievous and Count Dooku himself.<ref name="CWA: Card Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of the Kaliida Nebula<ref name="OEG:S1" /> was featured in the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. As it was spanned out over several episodes, the battle was one of the series' first major battles,<ref name="Anakin and Padmé Unite">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20081016.html|text=Padmé and Anakin Unite in ''The Clone Wars''}}</ref> appearing in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episodes "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]" and "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]."<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /><ref name="Destroy Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode004.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> In addition, the battle completed a three-part story arc in the series centered around the Confederate warship ''Malevolence'',<ref name="Anakin and Padmé Unite" /><ref name="Fighters Soar">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20081007.html|text=Fighters Soar This Week in ''Clone Wars''}}</ref> which made its first appearance in the television series in the episode "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> as well as [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], an issue of the series' [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|weekly online webcomic]] that led into the episode.<ref name="Shakedown" /> Several stories relating to the battle itself were featured in the [[Star Wars comic books|online comic]]; [[The Clone Wars: Procedure|''Procedure'']] depicted Anakin Skywalker's acquisition of the Y-wing bombers for the battle shortly before "Shadow of ''Malevolence'',"<ref name="Procedure" /> while [[The Clone Wars: Agenda|''Agenda'']] portrayed Palpatine's deception of Padmé Amidala, leading into "Destroy ''Malevolence''."<ref name="Agenda" />

The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] featured Obi-Wan Kenobi's duel with General Grievous aboard the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="Lightsaber Duels">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]''</ref> The battle was identified by name in the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''.<ref name="OEG:S1" /> In [[2010]], the battle was featured in the "Starfighter" mini-game of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], which introduced a slight inconsistency with "Shadow of ''Malevolence''." In the game, Skywalker pilots a Delta-7B interceptor during the initial attack on the ''Malevolence'',<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> while in the episode, Skywalker mans a BTL-B Y-wing starfighter with Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> This article assumes that the latter's interpretation is correct. The [[2011]] non-[[canon]]ical video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' featured the battle in its comical depictions of "Shadow of ''Malevolence''" and "Destroy ''Malevolence''."<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

The battle depicted the BTL-B Y-wing starfighters in use,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /> and also featured the series debut of the characters of Padmé Amidala and C-3PO.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence Ep Guide" /> Although the [[2012]] ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' claims that the battle takes place in 22 BBY,<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> it was assumed at the time to be an error given the then-establishment of the series in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] or later. [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 24|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 24]] cemented the battle's dating in 22 BBY.<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence" />
